scope: Independent Smart Factory AI source, data, Grad-CAM and offline regression review; live broker and database were not mutated by the reviewer.
overall_project_completion: Final performance and complete integrated delivery are assessed separately; this report is not a completion claim.

dataset_review.visual_label_result: The normal sample has no bounding box; each defect sample's generated box encloses the visible 3D defect. This is a four-sample visual check, not a full manual annotation audit.

gradcam_same_checkpoint_comparison.checkpoint: data/training/vision/weights/best.pt at review time, before final model selection
gradcam_same_checkpoint_comparison.method: One real forward/backward pass per held-out sample, simultaneously retaining raw final backbone Conv2d and its post-BN/SiLU Conv-block output.
gradcam_same_checkpoint_comparison.conclusion: Raw pre-BN Conv2d generated an entirely zero ReLU heatmap for scratch despite nonzero gradients. The final backbone Conv block output produced nonzero actual Grad-CAM for all four samples. Final-model maps and their metadata are assessed in vision.json.

findings.issue: The missing CONFIG import crashed first-start ONNX export.
Future health timestamps and stale line/fault observations authorized unsafe reset.
Scratch Grad-CAM became entirely zero at the raw pre-BN convolution.
findings.status: Post-BN/SiLU source fix independently rendered four interim samples; final vision.json also records four nonzero actual-gradient maps. Nonzero maps do not establish precise defect localization.

findings.issue: A single pending ROS scene slot could overwrite a conveyor-stop command.
findings.status: FIFO and repeated running-state source fixes reviewed; real physical interlock results are recorded separately in integration.json by the main implementation.

findings.issue: PdM benchmark feature extraction defaulted to 25 Hz while generated signals used observed approximately 15.915 Hz rotation.
findings.status: Benchmark now uses observed 15.915494309 Hz; five final runtime measurements averaged 0.941082664 ms and reported raw-array mean was independently verified.

findings.issue: Direct world.py execution put simulator/signal.py on the top-level import path, shadowing standard-library signal after CONFIG imports were added.
findings.status: Module invocation fixed; an actual offline subprocess using python3 -m simulator.world successfully generated and parsed the SDF.

modified_source_gradcam_check.checkpoint: Current interim best.pt loaded once; training had updated it since the earlier paired layer comparison

limits: Offline mock tests do not replace physical conveyor and live image/database integration checks; final one-command clone startup is assessed separately.
Final held-out mAP comes from vision.json; the independent ONNX/PT parity check did not consult labels, retrain or tune thresholds.
Latency is a model-processing benchmark including preprocessing and NMS, excluding JPEG decoding, persistence and Grad-CAM; this parity run made no new latency claims.
Dataset hash checks prevent exact image reuse but cannot establish real-world generalization.
Four rendered label samples and four Grad-CAM samples are explanatory checks, not independent accuracy benchmarks.
Nonzero Grad-CAM is not proof of precise defect localization. Background/product-edge emphasis can indicate coarse 8x8 representation or shortcut use.
Initial interim checkpoints were not archived by the reviewer; final parity identifies the distributed checkpoint and ONNX graph by SHA-256.

final_vision_parity.limits: Prediction equivalence check only; labels were not consulted, no retraining or threshold tuning; no new latency claims while live services run.

final_threshold_check.verification_method: Raw latency arrays recomputed; required thresholds inspected; final PT/ONNX prediction equivalence actually executed. Accuracy evaluation was performed separately by the main implementation, without test-based model selection.

additional_source_review.camera_configuration: Gazebo SDF camera FOV and width/height use CONFIG; changed FOV 1.05 and size 480 are confirmed in actual generated SDF XML.
additional_source_review.reproduction: The reproduction script stops live simulator/business services before launching a dataset-generation Gazebo, avoiding duplicate ROS2 publishers.
additional_source_review.module_startup: start.sh uses python3 -m simulator.world so simulator/signal.py cannot shadow standard-library signal through the direct script directory; actual offline subprocess succeeded and wrote valid SDF.

iso8601_regression: Optional fractional seconds and UTC Z/+00:00 strings accepted; 5-second bucket axis preserved
